title: Why does an AI invent details?

scenes.title: A language model writes word by word. At each step it picks a word …

captions.text: A language model writes word by word. At each step it picks a word that fits the text so far.

scenes.title: After “The team meets next …”, “Monday” fits very well. Whether it …

captions.text: After “The team meets next …”, “Monday” fits very well. Whether it is true, the model does not check.
A short pause to think: Why does the AI write “Monday”?

scenes.title: If the day is missing from the note, the model fills the gap with s…

captions.text: If the day is missing from the note, the model fills the gap with something plausible. But plausible does not mean supported.

scenes.title: That is why you check every concrete detail against the source: dat…

captions.text: That is why you check every concrete detail against the source: date, number, person, decision.
A short pause to think: What do you check first in an AI summary?
